€1Ā. (मचते) 
__1 To be wicked. 
__2 To cheat, deceive. 
__3 To be vain or proud. 
__4 To pound, ground.
A word used at the end of a noun to denote ‘excellence’ or ‘the best of its kind’; as गोमचर्चिका ‘an excellent cow or bull’; मतल्लिकादयो नियतलिङ्गा न तु विशिष्यनिघ्नाः [[Sk.]]; cf. उद्घः.

__1 A thief, robber, burglar. 
__2 A crocodile. 
__3 N. of a disease; [[L. D. B.]] 
__4 Sickness.
